Tessa (eng-ml): Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem  we need owners and concrete eval additions (regression cases, promptset, load profile, chaos drill). Can we assign now?
Jordan (eng-sre): I'll own the chaos drill + runbook update. Plan: staging drill to simulate partial KV loss + memory pressure. Target Wed 11:00. Need driver script and abort conditions.
Kai (eng-platform): I'll take infra/CI: ephemeral staging cluster + nightly job and PR smoke. Will create ticket STG-7001.
Mina (eng-ml): I'll own regression tests and promptset. Proposed matrix: seq=[128,512,2048], batch=[1,8], kernel=[fp16,int8], cache=[cold,warm]. ETA: Fri EOD.
Tessa (eng-ml): Add promptset cases: long-reference chains, repeating short tokens, and synthetic burst writes. Include a README explaining failure modes.
Mina (eng-ml): Example command to include in PR: `./tools/run_regression --case=burst_write --seq=2048 --kernel=int8 --check-fallback`
Jordan (eng-sre): Driver artifact I need: `scripts/induce_kv_partial --pct=30 --ramp=60 --safe` with abort if error_rate > 0.5% sustained. I'll add detection signals: KV_miss_rate, cache_eviction_rate, p99 latency.
Kai (eng-platform): CI plan: PR smoke = seq=128,batch=1,kernel=int8; nightly = full matrix. I'll post job URL and creds in the tracker.
Tessa (eng-ml): Owners + due dates to track: Mina=regressions+promptset (Fri), Jordan=chaos+runbook (Wed), Kai=infra+CI (Tue). I'll update the postmortem tracker and add pass criteria: 48h clean nightlies and p95 within 12% baseline.
IncidentBot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/pm/kv-eviction  action_items assigned.
Mina (eng-ml): I'll include int8 rounding and QAT toggles in the matrix as a risk axis.
Jordan (eng-sre): I'll add a runbook rule: if `runtime.kernel_fallback_count{kernel="int8"} > 3` in 15m, escalate to SRE on-call.
Tessa (eng-ml): Thanks all. Please paste PR links and this thread ts into the tracker so we can follow progress. We'll confirm in Monday standup and close items after 48h of stable nightly runs.
